senses.gloss: (? kotha, Finotʼs em. for ms. kutha, m.c., RP 〔14.6〕 (vs; meter requires length of first syllable) tṛṇa-kāṣṭhakotha-(mss. kutha)-sama paśyati sattvarūpaṃ; perhaps = Skt. kotha, rottenness or a foul abscess: he regards the form of beings as like (worthless, vile) grass, wood, or rottenness (?).)
